resources.string: Start once, then review Android requests in order. Every capability is optional. Android may show separate dialogs; special access opens Settings. Files and photos use system pickers without whole-library access.
Private and Full Power control processing, not Android grants. Access never authorizes an action, payment or continuous recording. Sensitive setup stays behind the existing grown-up controls.
Progress saved. Attempted or skipped does not mean allowed. Review actual Android access below; repair only what you need.
For voice input when you start listening. Typed chat works without it.
Find a saved contact by name for a requested phone action.
Show upcoming events when you ask.
Create events through the existing action approval flow.
Take a photo or use the flashlight when requested. Existing photos use a picker.
Optional location for relevant local results. Android lets you choose approximate access.
Find and connect a headset or glasses you select.
Transfer media from a supported device you connect.
Connect to a local model server or a nearby transfer endpoint.
Optional sensitive access to read notifications for summaries or approved replies. Android Settings controls this grant.
Optional sensitive access to inspect or operate another app only for your approved request. Enable the Halo service yourself in Android Settings.
Optional special access for requested brightness changes.
Optional special access for requested silent-mode changes.
Optional display over other apps for Floating Halo.
Optional Android assistant role. Choose Halo in system settings; this does not grant screen or microphone access.
Optional special access for reminders at an exact time. Android controls this grant.
